summary.text: Matt Woods, a Republican, has represented District 5 in the Alabama State Senate since June 25, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he earned an associate degree from Bevill State Community College in 2002 and a bachelor's degree in business administration from Auburn University in 2004.
His career experience includes working as manager of Jasper Auto Sales, and he has served on the Alabama Community College System Board of Trustees.
